state_binding.freshness: V43 evidence preserved as bounded candidate-geometry evidence; active design scope is function-first bottle handling.

intent: Define the bottle-handling requirements independently of any specific current mechanism: required support/restraint, intentionally permitted bottle rotation, indexing/capture/wrap/release state relationships, required contacts, and reaction needs. Use those requirements to compare and eliminate mechanism families before deterministic candidate geometry is selected or built.

projected_steps.title: Bind non-negotiable product and machine context for the D48 upright bottle at the label-application station
expected_outputs: fresh exact bottle/conveyor/CAB/current-contact identities when live CAD reads are needed
source classification for each bound geometric constraint

projected_steps.title: Derive state-by-state required bottle DOF, support, restraint, and intentionally permitted wrap rotation without assuming the Prism architecture
expected_outputs: required rotational restraint/permitted rotation by state
tip/lean and escape modes requiring control

projected_steps.title: Bind the minimum required bottle contact/support set and distinguish required functional contacts from incidental current-pose contacts
expected_outputs: current deterministic contacts mapped to roles where justified
missing contact roles preserved as geometry/design requirements

projected_steps.title: Re-activate and compare mechanism-family hypotheses only after bottle requirements are bound
expected_outputs: candidate mechanism families evaluated against common requirements
next geometry test selected by diagnostic value

acceptance_gate: No mechanism family is selected merely because it resembles the current v43 geometry. Bottle-handling requirements must be bound first. Static fit-check contact, visual plausibility, or AI reasoning cannot establish restraint, motion, force path, label-transfer coherence, or mechanical acceptance.
no_write_boundary: No SOLIDWORKS move, transform, rebuild, save, mate creation, suppression change, component insertion, or Remote Queue write is authorized by this plan.
